response.original_title: [FAQs-Guide] How to Add Another Passenger to Your Marella Cruise Reservation
response.overview: You cannot add a new passenger to an existing Marella Cruises reservation directly online +1-866-254-7549, so you must call customer service +1-866-254-7549 or use a travel agent to update your booking. How to Add a Passenger Call Customer Support: Reach out directly by phone at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK). You can also contact your original travel advisor +1-866-254-7549. Check Cabin Capacity: An agent will check if your current stateroom has space for an extra guest +1-866-254-7549 or double occupancy. They must also verify total ship lifeboat and safety limits. Book a Separate Cabin if Needed: If your cabin is full, the new passenger must book a separate room. You can then ask customer service to link the two reservation numbers together so your group shares dining times and activities +1-866-254-7549. Pay Additional Fees: Be prepared to pay the prevailing cruise fare, port taxes, and any extra charges for the new guest +1-866-254-7549.
